notes.title: UAYEB New Patch: Version 2.5
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993626/d6049cdd6c61e68e04c73ae2f0edd3aa8b68097a.jpg[/img]

[h1] UAYEB New Patch: Version 2.5 is available now[/h1]

Hello everyone,

Thank you so much for all your feedbacks from last week. Thanks to you all I could make this new patch with some good new improvements:

[h1] Release notes:	[/h1] 
[b]- Bug Fixes: [/b] The saving / loading crash issue is now fixed.
The issue was not coming from the game but from the code of the Cryengine version. 
If you had a crash before, you can now load your previous working file and you won't have any more crashes (loading the second last working file will be safer).
If you need, you still can request a backup saved game file with this form: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdrnieonWiA7YnXoP8FTliiu-Hbh7qh74snrsHxyXM86xRlCw/viewform] Form	[/url]
[b]- Price: [/b] The game price has been cut down to $19,99 usd.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] Reduction of the collisions for the small rocks, so that the car will not be affected by them and the driving is now smoother.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] The F5 button is implemented for Unlimited Quick Save (saving anywhere) and the 40 saving slots are removed when sleeping.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] The aiming is not affected anymore by the breathing animation, so aiming is now more precise.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] Drawers in Joanna's house are not accessible before getting the backpack to avoid confusion.
[b]- Bug Fixes: [/b] The piece of paper in the kitchen doesn't respawn anymore once it has been taken.

To support the game and make a recommendation, please post a Review with thumb up, on the main page: 
[url=store.steampowered.com/app/589220/UAYEB/] Main page[/url]

For ideas and suggestions please create new discutions so we can deal with each separatly on the forum:
[url=steamcommunity.com/app/589220/discussions/  ] Forum[/url]

Sorry for the large update, it was needed to rebuild the whole game.
The upades are done for now, and I'll be starting to work on the Episode 2.

Many thanks.

notes.title: UAYEB New Patch: Version 2.4
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993626/85754e054098e8799874a430154dc33697d30e05.jpg[/img]

[h1] UAYEB New Patch: Version 2.4 is available now[/h1]

Hello everyone,

Games are not only made by developers but also by the players.
Following on  your comments there are big changes that have been made on this patch to improve the gameplay and the game quality:

[h1] Release notes:	[/h1] 
[b]- Bug Fixes: [/b] The changes of the screen resolution in the graphic settings now fixed.
[b]- Bug Fixes: [/b] The Exit Game option from the main menu has changed and is it closing correctly now.
[b]- Bug Fixes: [/b] The Exit Game option from the ingame menu has changed, it goes back to the main menu. 
It may still take some time to close on slower machines but it is closing and exiting Steam properly.
[b]- Price: [/b] The game price has been cut down.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] Objectives in the inventory are now updated with more informations of what to do. Especially at the beginning.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] The hunger and thirst levels are going down slower than before. You won't die as quickly as before.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] The stamina level is going down slower, and regenerate faster as before.You'll be able to run longer than before and to wait less time to rest.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] It is now two times faster as before to dig with the pickaxe.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] It is now two times faster as before to unlock a door.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] It is now two times faster as before to sleep.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] It is now two times faster as before to craft anything.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] You need far less carbon to craft the lockpicks.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] You need half less carbon to craft the car.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] You have more chances to gather more crafting resources:
Iron = random number between 5 to 20
Carbon = random number between 5 to 20
Lead = random number between 10 to 20
Sulfur = random number between 5 to 20
Cables = random number between 2 to 10
Solar Cells = random number between 1 to 4
Cloth = random number between 10 to 25
Cotton = random number between 5 to 20
Peppermint = random number between 5 to 20
White willow = random number between 5 to 20

To support the game and make a recommendation, please post a Review with thumb up, on the main page: 
[url=store.steampowered.com/app/589220/UAYEB/] Main page[/url]

For ideas and suggestions please create new discutions so we can deal with each separatly on the forum:
[url=steamcommunity.com/app/589220/discussions/  ] Forum[/url]

Many thanks.

notes.title: UAYEB New Version 2.3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993626/ca9c1fa2c2b8a9173c5ac244fd8e272ad5ff8782.jpg[/img]

[h1] UAYEB New Version 2.3 is available now[/h1]

Hello everyone,

There is a new update today with this version 2.3.

[h1] Release notes:	[/h1] 
[b]- Bug Fixes: [/b] On loading a saved game.
[b]- Bug Fixes: [/b] Refresh values of the flashlight and computer battery levels when opening the inventory.
[b]- Bug Fixes: [/b] When under the potion effect, FX is now removed after loading a saved game.
[b]- Bug Fixes: [/b] Refresh and display correctly the values of the time and the battery levels on the solar panels screens.
[b]- Bug Fixes: [/b] When eating rotten food and bad water, the damages will occur once you drink or eat, and they don't repeate anymore (you won't die from that).
[b]- Bug Fixes: [/b] It is not possible to jump above the gate anymore.
[b]- Improvements: [/b] Highlight of the messages in the inventory when the cursor is over the message title.

[h1] For information:	[/h1] 
The beginning of the game in the house is a tutorial level to get used to the control  keys, the story, the gameplay mechanics and the inventory.

Once you have solved few puzzles and gather your first equipment, the game starts with the first mayan site. There are 20 different Mayan sites which are specific levels to collect 20 Mayan artifacts, each one with different puzzles, fights (or not), platforms and traps.

There are 12 equipment blueprints with 2 vehicles that you get through the story.
20 different crafting resources that can be collected in the open world.

Your friend Joanna will send you all the informations needed on your laptop, to follow your objectives. The world map will be unlocked once you discovered the city.
There are also 9 bonus sound tracks on  USB drives to find in the city.

You can make the UAYEB community grow with the Wiki at https://uayeb.gamepedia.com/UAYEB_Wiki

Many thanks for your support.

notes.title: UAYEB EP01 VERSION 2.0 is OUT NOW
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/-A8pjicFS1Q
[h1] The version 2.0 is now available! [/h1]
[b] Be aware that the saved files from version 1 will not be working on version 2, as it is a complete new version.
If you have started playing on version 1, before starting a new game on V2, I would advise you to remove the "user" folder from your UAYEB root folder.[/b]

[h1] You want to keep your progression from V1 to V2?  [/h1]
[b] No worries, yes you can![/b]
If you have started playing on version 1.0 and you want to keep on with the same progress on version 2.0, please fill up this form to receive your new save files by email.
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdrnieonWiA7YnXoP8FTliiu-Hbh7qh74snrsHxyXM86xRlCw/viewform] Fill up this form	[/url]

[h1] List of changes on version 2.0:	[/h1] 
- The price has been cut down
- The crash after too many saved game is fixed
- The saving system has changed to auto saves (checkpoints throughout the whole levels)
- A new free save system has been implemented, after sleeping in a bed you'll be prompted to save your progress or not (40 saving slots available)
- A LOAD option has been implemented in the main menu and ingame menu
- The full list of saved files are visible from that LOAD scrolling menu
- You will be able to load or delete saved files from the LOAD menu
- Invisible collisions have been removed
- Adjustments on Mayan sites were done to avoid going in wrong directions
(Mayan site 4, 5, 10, 17, 18,19)
- Bugs fixing in Joanna's house, like bedroom or gun disapearing, now fixed
- Changes in Joanna's house where two triggers were too close. Now fixed (paper note, wardrobes, safe)
- Minor bugs fixed (camera Mayan site 12)
- A anti cheats has been added, if you like the game please support the project by buying it
- A new trailer video was done for the release of V2.0

[b]Thanks everyone for your support, comments and recommendations.[/b]

[h1] UAYEB Episode 1 is OUT NOW! [/h1]

[b] I'm glad to announce that UAYEB Episode 1 is NOW OUT!	[/b]

UAYEB is a singleplayer story-driven adventure and puzzle game, with survival and crafting elements. 

Players take on the role of Uayeb, a game developer in a past life, now lost in a forgotten land retaken by nature. With the help of your friend Joanna, you will explore and survive in this hostile environment, unveiling clues and artifacts leading to the lost Mayan civilization.

This is an Indie game made by one person.

notes.title: The blurred will be removed from the game
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993626/fad9c0a50183a80b26bbdea8117f278deb02229a.jpg[/img]
[h1] Changes made for the game based on your feedback	[/h1]
Thanks for your feedback on the demo, your comments changed the game as follow:

1 - The blurred vision will be corrected for the game (clear vision close by, blurred vision far away, with ice on the screen).
2 - Tutorial pop ups screens have been added to help you through the game.
3 - When your Stamina is down to zero, you will not lose health anymore, but you will just slow down, and you will get stuck until your Stamina bar is getting up again.
4 - Jump will be by pressing space bar.
5 - Changing resolution issue in main menu is fixed.

Lots of bugs are being fixed for final release version.

All productive comments will be taken in consideration before the release date to bring you a better game.
Thank you!

notes.title: Tip 04: Drinking
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993626/a25b3b211838882e69882f6a7d2e01b872e652a2.jpg[/img]

[h1] Tip 04: Drinking	[/h1]
Before drinking water somewhere, fill up a bottle and check the color to be sure that it is drinkable.
Then you can drink from a water point, by pressing the «X» key several times to fill up your thirst bar.
Always keep your empty bottles filled up with fresh water before you go on expedition.

notes.title: Tip 03: Inventory Shortcuts
notes.content:

[h1] Tip 03: Inventory Shortcuts	[/h1]
You have few shortcut keys to access quickly your inventory:

On a QUERTY keyboard:
E = Open the laptop Inventory

The following keys are the inventory Tabs:
R = Map
T = Crafting
Y = Artifacts
U = Music

The following keys are the Crafting Tabs:
F = Vehicle
G = Health
H = Ammunition
J = Accessory

notes.title: Tip 02: Stamina
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993626/256d89f1f61f5cda0e2677de63519f7b24d9dc2d.jpg[/img]
[h1] Tip 02: Stamina	[/h1]
When your Stamina level is down, you will be slowing down as you are too tired, in that case stop running (release the Shift key). 
The warning red icon on the bottom left of your screen will show you when to stop pressing the Shift key.
It is the same underwater, if you swim fast for too long you will lose health as your stamina will be down.
Check the oxigen bar on the top of your screen, when it reatches the stamina icon, then you can swim faster by pressing Shift.

notes.title: Tip 01: Saving
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27993626/ee4ff3fa1a9c24785cf759672f7761d71e136390.jpg[/img]
[h1] TIP 01: Saving	[/h1]
The bad news is that you will die a lot.
The good news is that you will manage your progress yourself, and you will be able to save anywhere at any time.

F5 is the quick save key in the game.
